shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عامر بن لحى

notes: Two branches of «ح» meet at Isa; the text writes the rest of the chain once, after the second branch, so it is the shared tail.
«- وهذا لفظ إبراهيم -» is an editor gloss; «قال عيسى قال ثور وهو اليوم الثاني» is a commentary on the day, not a route; Isa is not identified further.
The Prophet is the end of the chain.
